📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-28-mobile-asyncstorage-securestore-keychain`
This is occurrence #14 (gate open — last notified 2026-06-25T16:07Z, >6 days ago).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Service Delivery` (`@service-delivery` / `#team-service-delivery`)
Playbook: 1) Confirm volume + app version in ES: fields.dd_service:"nonprod/apps" AND message:ERR_KEY_CHAIN — 2) Check if iOS app version still v2.1.651 (the affected version) — 3) File defect with mobile team if persisting
Open Jira: n/a (fix_status: needs-human)

Source alerts (1 total — degraded cycle, DD+ES sourced):
  • https://methodintegration.slack.com/archives/C03TYHGRS23/p1782992333000001  (alert-frontend-errors, 11:38 UTC — synthetic, no Slack MCP)

Evidence:
  • ES query: fields.dd_service.keyword:"nonprod/apps" AND message:*ERR_KEY_CHAIN* (level:Error)
  • ES result: 1,673 hits in window 2026-07-02T11:38–12:43Z (~25.7/min; prev occ#13 was ~38/min on 2026-06-25T22:08Z — decelerating trend continues)
  • Kibana: https://logstash.method.me/app/discover#/?_g=(time:(from:'2026-07-02T11:38:53Z',to:'2026-07-02T12:43:53Z'))&_a=(query:(language:kuery,query:'fields.dd_service%3A%22nonprod%2Fapps%22%20AND%20message%3AERR_KEY_CHAIN'))
  • This-window concentration: nonprod/apps 1,673 — "Failed to migrate from AsyncStorage to SecureStore: {\"code\":\"ERR_KEY_CHAIN\"}" — Method iOS app

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-24-runtime-core-rtc-p95-recurring`
This is occurrence #207 (tracked since 2026-05-24; >6 days since last notification).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Vertical App Experience` (`@sales management` / `#team-sales-management`)
Playbook: 1) Confirm pattern with dd_search.py metric screen-load endpoint — ≥4 points >3.0s in window confirms. 2) Confirm latency-only: DD logs for runtime-core-api errors should return 0. 3) Inspect DD APM traces for slow spans (SQL/Mongo/Redis). 4) Tag breakdown by @account_name for per-tenant root cause.
Open Jira: n/a — fix_jira not yet filed

Source alerts (1 total — degraded cycle, DD-sourced):
  • DD monitor 115456700 fired 13:06:20Z 2026-07-02 (Warn→OK, no Slack message in degraded mode)

Root-cause analysis:
  Query run: `p95:trace.aspnet_core.request{env:prod,service:runtime-core-api,resource_name:post_/api/v1/runtime/load/_screenid*}` (12:03-13:10Z)
  Observed: 4 points over 3.0s threshold in cluster 12:58:20-12:59:20Z
  Peak: 7.985s at 12:58:40Z (2.7× threshold)
  Latency-only confirmed: 0 error logs for runtime-core-api in window

Corroborate independently:
  Run: python scripts/dd_search.py metric --query "p95:trace.aspnet_core.request{env:prod,service:runtime-core-api,resource_name:post_/api/v1/runtime/load/_screenid*}" --from-unix 1782993780 --to-unix 1782997680
  Expected: 4 points over 3.0s, peak at 12:58:40Z

Evidence:
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/115456700
  • DD APM traces (12:58-13:00Z spike, >3s): https://app.datadoghq.com/apm/traces?query=service%3Aruntime-core-api%20%40duration%3A%3E3s&start=1782997080000&end=1782997200000
  • Kibana: n/a — datadog_apm evidence source (no ES signal for latency-only)
  • This-window: runtime-core-api screen-load 4 pts >3s, peak 7.985s — latency-only, 0 error logs
